Batavia ( bə-TAY-vee-ə) is a village in and the county seat of Clermont County, Ohio, United States. The population was 1,509 at the 2010 census.


== Geography ==

Batavia is located at 39°4′38″N 84°10′45″W (39.077332, -84.179160).According to the United States Census Bureau, the village has a total area of 1.62 square miles (4.20 km2), of which 1.59 square miles (4.12 km2) is land and 0.03 square miles (0.08 km2) is water.
